free_tier.stated: The tracker's cheapest NolimitHost row is an IPv6-only Budget VPS at EUR 12.99/year (EUR 1.08/month derived): 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB NVMe, IPv6-only, Frankfurt. The vendor's own billing API confirms it as BVPS-IPV6ONLY-Offers at EUR 12.99 with annual the only base billing period enabled (biennial -3 percent, triennial -5 percent), stock 9, active, and the plan's cart page prints EUR 12.99 Annual, EUR 25.20 Biennial at -3 percent and EUR 37.02 Triennial at -5 percent, with 2 TB of bandwidth, a 500 Mbit/s uplink and no stock badge. Budget VPS 1 (2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 40 GB NVMe) is EUR 10.99 per quarter on the billing API and its cart page (monthly not offered; semi-annual -3, annual -5, biennial -8, triennial -10 percent; the cart prints EUR 21.32 semi-annual, EUR 41.76 annual, EUR 80.89 biennial and EUR 118.69 triennial), stock 4, EUR 3.66/month derived; the Budget table no longer appears on the vendor VPS page, which now lists only the Premium plans. Premium VPS 1 (1 vCPU, 2 GB, 20 GB NVMe) is EUR 5.99/month on the billing API; its cart page prints EUR 17.07 quarterly at -5 percent, EUR 33.06 semi-annual at -8 percent, EUR 64.69 annual at -10 percent, EUR 126.51 biennial at -12 percent and EUR 183.29 triennial at -15 percent, with stock 7 and no stock badge on the cart. Renewal: not published.
